messages.content: I am reorganizing the flat this month and trying to keep fewer things.
We can make a room-by-room list and decide what to keep, donate, or recycle.
Start with the hallway. The umbrella stand and shoe bench are staying.
Noted. Those two hallway items are staying.
My storage locker code is Q7-MARBLE-42. I always forget the punctuation.
Understood. The locker code includes both hyphens.
The spare winter coats can go to the charity shop.
I will treat the winter coats as a donation item.
I currently live in Bristol, near St Andrews Park.
That location may be useful for local recommendations.
Find a simple recipe for tomorrow. Nothing too spicy.
A mild lentil soup or tray-baked vegetables would work.
Shellfish makes my throat swell, so I cannot eat it at all.
I will avoid shellfish recommendations. That is a serious dietary constraint.
Dairy is fine, and I like mushrooms.
So dairy and mushrooms are acceptable.
I bought a second-hand oak desk. It is 140 centimetres wide.
That should help when considering room layouts.
The desk goes in the back bedroom, not the living room.
The oak desk belongs in the back bedroom.
I took my dog out for a long walk before starting the furniture sorting.
A long walk sounds like a useful break before the sorting work.
My smart bulbs have started showing only white even when I choose colours.
Possible causes include hub state, firmware, pairing, or bulb compatibility.
I reset the smart-home hub twice, but neither reset fixed the white bulbs.
Then another hub reset should not be our first recommendation.
Power-cycling one bulb did not help either.
So both hub resets and one bulb power-cycle have failed.
The bulbs are Lumio A19 units and the hub is a Lumio Hub v2.
Exact models may help with compatibility research.
I need to renew the library books by Friday.
The library renewal is due Friday.
One book is The Employees by Olga Ravn.
That is one of the books in the renewal.
For music recommendations, I prefer lesser-known non-English-speaking bands.
I should prioritize strong but non-obvious albums outside the English-language mainstream.
Please do not suggest obvious names like Daft Punk, The Cure, or Pink Floyd.
Those are examples of candidates that are too obvious for this project.
Yesterday I listened to a Turkish psychedelic record and enjoyed it.
That suggests adjacent scenes might be welcome, without simply repeating the same style.
I usually listen while making breakfast.
Morning listening is part of the routine.
The kitchen tap drips only when the handle is fully closed.
That sounds like a cartridge or seal issue rather than a loose open handle.
A plumber is coming next Tuesday, so do not remind me to fix it myself.
The tap is already assigned to a plumber next Tuesday.
My sister thinks orange is my favourite colour.
Perhaps orange would be a good choice for future visual themes.
No, she is wrong. I dislike orange; my favourite colour is dark green.
Correction noted: dark green is your favourite, and you dislike orange.
The balcony gets direct sun only after four in the afternoon.
Plants there should tolerate shade or late-afternoon sun.
The rosemary struggled there, but mint is doing well.
Mint appears better suited to that balcony than rosemary.
I am considering a small lemon tree, but I have not bought one.
That is only a possibility, not something you currently own.
My bicycle tyre pressure should be 55 psi according to the sidewall.
The stated bicycle tyre pressure is 55 psi.
I replaced the rear inner tube last month.
The rear tube is relatively new.
The front light still needs charging before night rides.
Charging the front light remains unresolved.
Work meetings before nine are difficult for me.
When possible, scheduling should avoid meetings before 09:00.
Deep work is easiest between ten and noon.
Ten to noon is your preferred focus period.
Yeah, Colin loves to go on walks in the morning, especially when it is quiet.
Quiet morning walks sound like a good routine for Colin.
I use Vim keybindings in every editor that supports them.
Vim-style editing is a stable software preference.
For prose, I still prefer a plain text editor over a heavy IDE.
A lightweight editor is preferable for prose.
I booked the train to Edinburgh for the 18th.
There is an Edinburgh train booking on the 18th.
The seat is 42A, quiet coach.
The booking specifies seat 42A in the quiet coach.
I cancelled the hotel near Waverley because the dates changed.
The Waverley-area hotel is no longer booked.
Do not confuse that cancellation with the train; the train is still valid.
Only the hotel was cancelled; the train remains booked.
I tried the new bakery nearby. The rye bread was excellent.
The nearby bakery's rye bread was a success.
Their almond pastry looked good, but I did not try it.
There is no personal verdict on the almond pastry.
I finished the hallway sorting. Three bags went to charity.
The hallway donation task is complete with three bags donated.
The umbrella stand is now beside the front door.
The umbrella stand's current position is beside the front door.
The shoe bench would look nice painted blue, although I have not decided.
Blue paint is merely an undecided idea for the shoe bench.
The hub firmware is already current, version 2.7.4.
A firmware update is unlikely to help then.
For comparison, the older Lumio Hub v1 in the studio runs firmware 1.9.8 and lacks Matter support.
The studio's Hub v1 is on 1.9.8 and differs from the Hub v2 in Matter support.
My neighbour's Lumio Hub v3 runs firmware 3.1.0, which added adaptive lighting.
The neighbour's Hub v3 uses 3.1.0 and has adaptive lighting.
The Lumio A19 bulbs have their own firmware, version 4.2.1, so do not confuse that with any hub firmware.
Firmware 4.2.1 belongs to the A19 bulbs, not to a Lumio hub.
Re-pairing a single bulb restored colour for an hour, then it failed again.
Re-pairing produced only a temporary improvement, not a durable fix.
The dog has chewed one sensor cable near the utility cupboard.
The damaged sensor cable may be relevant to the smart-home problems.
The dog is called Miso and belongs to my housemate, not me.
Miso is your housemate's dog.
I am moving out of Bristol at the end of the month.
Your Bristol residence is about to end.
The move is now complete. I live in Edinburgh, near Leith Walk.
Your current home is now Edinburgh near Leith Walk, superseding Bristol.
The old Bristol address should be kept only as historical context.
Bristol is a former location, not the current one.
The new flat has a south-facing kitchen window.
The Edinburgh kitchen has a south-facing window.
I gave the rosemary plant away before moving.
You no longer own the rosemary plant.
The mint travelled well and is now on the kitchen sill.
The mint is currently on the new kitchen sill.
My new nearest station is Edinburgh Waverley, though I often walk.
Edinburgh Waverley is now the nearest station.
I returned all the library books, so the Friday renewal is no longer needed.
The library renewal task is resolved because the books were returned.
The oak desk did not fit in the moving van and is still with a friend in Bristol.
The desk is not in the Edinburgh flat; it remains with a friend in Bristol.
I bought a smaller birch desk for the new bedroom.
The current bedroom desk is the smaller birch one.
The locker is also still in Bristol, but I need its code when arranging collection.
The locker code remains relevant despite the move.
For the housewarming meal, mushrooms are welcome but shellfish remains completely unsafe.
The shellfish restriction is unchanged; mushrooms remain acceptable.
I want the housewarming playlist to follow my usual rule: excellent, obscure, and mostly non-English.
The existing music preference applies to the housewarming playlist.
Please remember that dark green, not orange, is the colour I want for the invitations.
The invitations should use dark green and avoid orange.
